title: Three anti-invariant classes on a nonintegrable four-manifold
strongest_verified_claim: On the specified closed connected genus-two-curve times elliptic-curve four-manifold, a smooth compactly supported family of almost-complex deformations converges to the product complex structure, retains three fixed independent real de Rham classes with closed anti-invariant representatives, and is nonintegrable for every sufficiently small nonzero real parameter. This contradicts the unrestricted DLZ Conjecture 2.5 as stated.
exclusions: exact h-minus dimension for nonzero parameter
fixed compatible metric or symplectic form
proof_families: global compactification and Stokes cohomology argument
arbitrary-cutoff exterior identities and positive-plane realization
full core Nijenhuis tensor and local type obstruction

portable_modes: outer optimized with checker assertions forced
